CONTINUING GUARANTY

This Continuing Guaranty (this "Guaranty") is made as of May 4, 2026 by Dermot Halloran, an individual residing in Waterbury, Connecticut ("Guarantor"), in favor of Buckeye Fifth Bank, N.A. ("Lender").

RECITALS

Lender has agreed to extend credit to Halloran Precision Castings, LLC (the "Borrower") under a Credit Agreement of even date (the "Credit Agreement"). Lender's willingness to extend that credit is conditioned on Guarantor executing this Guaranty. Guarantor is a member of the Borrower and will benefit from the credit.

1. Guaranty of Payment.

Guarantor absolutely, unconditionally, and irrevocably guarantees to Lender the full and prompt payment when due, whether at stated maturity, by acceleration, or otherwise, of all present and future indebtedness, obligations, and liabilities of the Borrower to Lender under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, together with all interest, fees, and costs of collection, including reasonable attorneys' fees (the "Guaranteed Obligations"). This is a guaranty of payment and not merely of collection.

2. Continuing and Unlimited.

This Guaranty is continuing and applies to all Guaranteed Obligations, including those arising after the date of this Guaranty. Guarantor's liability is not limited in amount.

3. Independent Obligation.

Guarantor's obligations are independent of the Borrower's. Lender may bring a separate action against Guarantor without first proceeding against the Borrower, any other guarantor, or any collateral, and without joining the Borrower in any action.

4. Waivers.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Guarantor waives: notice of acceptance of this Guaranty; presentment, demand, protest, and notice of dishonor; notice of the creation or increase of any Guaranteed Obligation; any requirement that Lender exhaust remedies or proceed first against the Borrower or any collateral; any defense based on the Borrower's incapacity, dissolution, or discharge in bankruptcy; and any right of subrogation, reimbursement, indemnity, or contribution against the Borrower until the Guaranteed Obligations are paid in full in cash.

5. Reinstatement.

If any payment applied to the Guaranteed Obligations is later rescinded or must be returned on the Borrower's insolvency, this Guaranty is reinstated as to the amount returned, whether or not this Guaranty has been cancelled.

6. Modifications Do Not Discharge.

Lender may, without notice to or consent from Guarantor and without discharging Guarantor, renew, extend, accelerate, amend, or restructure the Guaranteed Obligations; release or substitute any collateral or any other guarantor; and apply payments as it elects.

7. Representations.

Guarantor represents that Guarantor has full capacity to enter into this Guaranty, that it is enforceable against Guarantor, that Guarantor has independently reviewed the Borrower's financial condition and is not relying on Lender for information about it, and that Lender has no duty to inform Guarantor of any change in that condition.

8. Financial Information.

Guarantor shall deliver to Lender a personal financial statement and a copy of Guarantor's federal income tax return within thirty (30) days after filing, and in any event annually by June 30.

9. Termination.

Guarantor may terminate this Guaranty as to Guaranteed Obligations arising after termination by giving Lender sixty (60) days prior written notice; termination does not affect any Guaranteed Obligation arising before the notice period ends, or any renewal or extension of it.

10. Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Jury Waiver.

This Guaranty is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. Guarantor consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in Franklin County, Ohio, and waives any objection to venue there. GUARANTOR AND LENDER EACH WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION RELATING TO THIS GUARANTY.

11. Miscellaneous.

This Guaranty binds Guarantor's heirs, executors, and administrators, and inures to Lender's successors and assigns. No waiver by Lender is effective unless in writing. If any provision is unenforceable, the remainder continues in effect. This Guaranty may be amended only by a writing signed by Guarantor and Lender.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Guarantor has executed this Guaranty as of the date first written above.

/s/ Dermot Halloran
Dermot Halloran, Guarantor
